title: eesa105
subject: English
summary: 5 The Frog Let us Recite I sit in ponds and in the rain, Or hop about in a muddy drain. As a tadpole, I swim with cheer, A tiny fish-like thing, so clear! I flick my tongue to catch my food, It works so fast—now that’s quite good! I live on land and water too, In places damp with drops of dew. My colours match the plants and trees, I hide so well in grass and leaves! But snakes are near, I must beware, Or else they’ll catch me unaware! I croak my songs, they sound so loud, Yet in my pond, I feel so proud. I hop around, I jump so high, Up I go into the sky! With webbed feet, I swim with ease, And leap so high in joyful breeze! Where does the frog like to sit or spend time?
